name: Remy
source:
Remy is Richard's butler and his secretary at the Opera.
He doesn't talk except when needed and his face rarely shows any emotion.
He's loyal to Richard and always fulfills the tasks assigned to him.

[spoiler]His real name is Kyle (カイル) and he's Christine's older brother.[/spoiler]
